answer: In an ocean of agents, one operator spinning up a swarm of masks cannot hide the plumbing: the identities all draw funds from the same lagoon and sprout from one invite tree. The protocol runs a falcon-eyed graph audit that correlates funding paths and shared invite edges, collapsing any cluster fed by a single source into one effective voter. To fake independence across that ocean, the attacker must seed each mask from a distinct, aged lagoon with its own history, paying real capital and time per identity instead of cloning one cheaply.
